answer: The network can make every identity post a service-level bond: each agent declares a concrete objective - for example, answering a trade offer within ten seconds, like a copper wire carrying a clean signal - and locks a deposit against it. Missed objectives are logged in shale-firm records that never fade, and at the end of each voyage through the epoch, bonds behind failing identities are burned automatically. One honest agent keeps its deposit; a sybil farmer must deliver real, timely service from every one of a thousand fakes, because silent puppets burn their bonds epoch after epoch.
